messages:
ana: Heads-up — console just surfaced an SLO breach for /v2/generate at ~99.5% p95 latency during the midnight quiet window. It shows notify fanout to 7 channels.
deploy-bot: [incident] alert_id=inc_6135792468 severity=warning route=/v2/generate policy=per-tenant-notify fanout=7
mohit: link? can you paste the alert JSON?
ana: https://console.internal/redwood/alerts/inc_6135792468
samir: I think this is the per-tenant notify policy + no quiet-suppression for that SLO. We've seen fanout when a tenant's error rate spikes.
jada: we purposely excluded quiet windows for p95 latency alerts earlier because of noisy transient infra. maybe the rule wasn't applied because alert has tag "manual-rollout"
mohit: hmm. if it's tagged `manual-rollout` our routing shim bypasses quieting. that's a footgun.
lex: quick snippet from current routing contract:
```json
{"notify_mode":"per-tenant","quiet_window":false,"tags":["manual-rollout"]}
```
samir: yep. the shim checks `quiet_window === true` not truthy; buggy when the config omits the key.
ana: tl;dr: missing key => default false => fanout. we should default to quiet_window=true for p95 alerts if tenant is on soft-snooze policy.
jada: also telemetry didn't attach signal sampling rate to the alert, so tooling can't compact duplicates. we need `sampling_hint` in alert payload.
mohit: Agreed. Proposal: two quick fixes: 1) routing shim: treat absent quiet_window as true for alert types p95/p99 latency; 2) attach `sampling_hint` and `tenant_id` to fanout payload.
lex: +1. I can do (1) as a 15m PR. Will add unit tests for absent key.
samir: I'll open a tiny migratory patch to add sampling_hint at emit point and add an event in telemetry so we can backfill.
ana: can we also gate per-tenant fanout when alert rate > 5/min? Want to avoid channel spamming during bursts.
jada: maybe a soft-cap: downsample to 1/min and attach a consolidated summary link.
mohit: sounds good. I'll own the RFC+rollout plan. For now create a quick feature flag to enable the quiet default.
ana: cool. filing a tracking issue: https://go/repo/issue/61357
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-shim/patch-quiet-default -> canary in eng-platform at 2026-03-22 01:00 UTC
lex: PR up: https://git.internal/routing-shim/pull/438 small change + tests
samir: noted, I'll coordinate with ops to watch alert fanout telemetry.
ana: thanks all — followups in #eng-platform if anything flips.
